description: This file contains the XmlScanner class which performs security scans on XML content to prevent XXE/XEE vulnerabilities. It includes methods for pattern matching, charset detection, and handling external entity loads.

classes.name: XmlScanner
classes.description: A class that provides methods to scan XML content for security threats such as ENTITY usage that could lead to XXE/XEE attacks. It manages charset detection, encoding verification, and disables potentially dangerous libxml features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the pattern for detecting the document type and disabling entity loader.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method returning an instance configured based on the type of reader (HTML or others).

methods.name: threadSafeLibxmlDisableEntityLoaderAvailability
methods.description: Checks if the environment supports thread-safe disabling of entity loader via libxml.

methods.name: disableEntityLoaderCheck
methods.description: Disables libxml external entity loading for security, if supported.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Restores libxml entity loader setting at shutdown.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Ensures shutdown is called upon object destruction.

methods.name: setAdditionalCallback
methods.description: Allows setting an additional callback to process XML after initial scan.

methods.name: forceString
methods.description: Static utility to ensure the argument is returned as a string.

methods.name: toUtf8
methods.description: Converts input XML string to UTF-8 encoding, detects unsafe encodings like UTF-7, and handles BOM removal.

methods.name: findCharSet
methods.description: Detects charset from the XML declaration or BOM, disallowing EBCDIC encodings.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Scans the input XML for ENTITY patterns to prevent XXE/XEE, and converts encoding as needed.

methods.name: scanFile
methods.description: Reads and scans XML content from a file stream.
